dialogue.origin: はじめさせて頂きます、宜しくお願い致しますね。
dialogue.content: Let's begin. I look forward to our session today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 両親に色んな意味で足を引っ張られてる感じがして、嫌なんです。
dialogue.content: I feel like my parents are holding me back in many ways, and I don’t like it.

dialogue.origin: 自分が何かしようとすると、邪魔をされる感じ。
dialogue.content: Whenever I try to do something, it feels like they're getting in my way.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！すみません、年齢と、性別教えて頂けますか
dialogue.content: I see. May I ask your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: すいません。30歳て女性です
dialogue.content: Oh, sorry. I'm a 30-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: はい、分かりました。もう少し詳しく教えて頂けますか
dialogue.content: Okay, I understand. Could you please tell me a little more about that?

dialogue.origin: 本当は1人暮らしをしようと思って、お金を貯めていたんです。ところが、父が倒れてしまって貯めていたお金は入院費に。看病する人もいないので、私がなんだかんだ世話をしなきゃいけない。
dialogue.content: I was actually saving money to live on my own. But then my father collapsed, and the money I'd saved went toward his hospital bills. There's no one else to look after him, so I'm the one who has to take care of everything.

dialogue.origin: タイミングが悪いというか。
dialogue.content: It feels like such bad timing.

dialogue.origin: うん、うん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 昔から自分が何かしようとすると、反対されたり、小言言われたりする事が多かったんです
dialogue.content: Ever since I was young, whenever I tried to do something, they'd often oppose it or nag me about it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！せっかくお金を貯めてぃたのに、
dialogue.content: I see. And after you'd worked so hard to save that money...

dialogue.origin: 悲しいです。
dialogue.content: It's sad.

dialogue.origin: 悲しいですよね
dialogue.content: It is sad, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 家族とかご兄弟はいらっしゃいますか
dialogue.content: Do you have any other family or siblings?

dialogue.origin: 妹がいますが、もう結婚して家を出ました。
dialogue.content: I have a younger sister, but she's already married and has moved out.

dialogue.origin: 遠いし、子供も小さいし、頼れないです。
dialogue.content: She lives far away and has small children, so I can't really rely on her.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それで、お姉さんであるあなたを頼りなんですね
dialogue.content: I see. So they're relying on you, as the older sister.

dialogue.origin: 母もいるけど、あまり身体が強くないので、頼りにくいし。
dialogue.content: My mother is around, but she's not very strong physically, so it's hard to rely on her either.

dialogue.origin: 基本的に私がしています。
dialogue.content: So basically, I'm the one doing everything.

dialogue.origin: ご両親はおいくつですか
dialogue.content: How old are your parents?

dialogue.origin: 65です
dialogue.content: They're 65.

dialogue.origin: 二人とも。
dialogue.content: Both of them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！まだまだお若いですね
dialogue.content: I see. They're still quite young.

dialogue.origin: 脳梗塞て父が倒れてしまって。
dialogue.content: My father collapsed from a stroke.

dialogue.origin: 倒れてしまったのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so he collapsed.

dialogue.origin: それまではすごく元気で仕事してたから、家を出れると思ったんです
dialogue.content: He was very healthy and still working until then, so I thought I'd be able to move out.

dialogue.origin: 私も30だし、自分の人生しっかり歩もうと思って。
dialogue.content: I’m 30 now, and I wanted to really start living my own life.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！お母さんはあまり、じ丈夫ではないし
dialogue.content: I understand. And your mother isn’t very strong either…

dialogue.origin: 夫婦でそれなりに生活出来ると思っていました。
dialogue.content: I thought they would be able to manage on their own as a couple.

dialogue.origin: そうですよぬ
dialogue.content: Yes, I can understand that.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: しっかり貯金もたまり、これからという時に
dialogue.content: You had steadily saved your money, and just when you were about to start fresh…

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 物件も良さげな部屋もあったのに。
dialogue.content: I had even found a nice apartment.

dialogue.origin: 心折れます。
dialogue.content: It's just heartbreaking.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！家まで、考えていたんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you'd even thought as far as finding a place.

dialogue.origin: 仕事もしていたけど、コロナの影響でなくなってしまって。
dialogue.content: I was working, but I lost my job due to the pandemic.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: でも、失業保険と貯金があるから、どうにかなるとも思っていました。
dialogue.content: But I thought I'd manage somehow with unemployment benefits and my savings.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。仕事もなくなってはつらいですよね
dialogue.content: I see. It must be tough to lose your job as well.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 心機一転でやり直したいと思っていました
dialogue.content: I wanted to make a fresh start.

dialogue.origin: そのきっかけを失ったという感じ
dialogue.content: I feel like I've lost that chance.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！このことは、どなたかに相談されたのですか
dialogue.content: I see. Have you talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.origin: なかなか言えないです
dialogue.content: It's hard to talk about.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I can imagine.

dialogue.origin: 友達も結婚した人が多くて、話題が合わない感じなので。
dialogue.content: Many of my friends are married, and it feels like we don't have much in common to talk about anymore.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 子供の事とかご主人さんの事とか
dialogue.content: Things about their kids or their husbands…

dialogue.origin: そういうのを聞くと、また自分ばっかり取り残されているというか、
dialogue.content: When I hear that, it just makes me feel like I'm the only one being left behind again.

dialogue.origin: 何でなんだろうと思います。
dialogue.content: I wonder why it has to be this way.

dialogue.origin: 好きでやってる訳じゃないし。
dialogue.content: It’s not like I’m doing this because I want to.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そぅ、思ったしまいますよね。皆さん、じぶんのことでいっぱいになって居るんですね
dialogue.content: Mmm, yes, it's natural to feel that way. It seems everyone is preoccupied with their own lives.

dialogue.origin: 自分の事でですか。
dialogue.content: With their own lives?

dialogue.origin: 自分ではなく、家族の事などちで、余裕がなくなって居るんですね。
dialogue.content: Not just themselves, but with their families and so on, they don't have much emotional capacity left.

dialogue.origin: 押し付けられている感じがするんです
dialogue.content: I feel like things are being forced on me.

dialogue.origin: 都合の悪い事とか。
dialogue.content: Like all the inconvenient things.

dialogue.origin: 独身だからとかお姉ちゃんだからとか。
dialogue.content: Because I’m single, or because I’m the older sister.

dialogue.origin: 時間があるように見えたり、まるで義務の様に言われる
dialogue.content: It's like they assume I have free time, and they talk to me as if it's my duty.

dialogue.origin: そういうのが結構辛いんです
dialogue.content: That's what's really hard for me.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、押し付けられている。どんなことを押し付けられるのですか
dialogue.content: I see, you feel things are being forced on you. What kinds of things are they?

dialogue.origin: 今回の父の事とか。
dialogue.content: Like this whole situation with my father.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 妹は「手伝えなくてごめんね」と口ばかりな感じを受けます。
dialogue.content: My sister says things like, "I'm sorry I can't help," but it feels like she's all talk.

dialogue.origin: 本当にそう思うなら、少しでもお金送るとか、何か方法があると思う
dialogue.content: If she really felt that way, she could send some money or find some other way to help.

dialogue.origin: コロナの影響で見舞は入れないから仕方ないけど、せめて実家に1度来るとか、
dialogue.content: I know she can't visit him in the hospital because of COVID, but she could at least come to our parents' house once.

dialogue.origin: 何かうまい事逃げられていいなと思ってしまうんです
dialogue.content: I can't help but think how nice it must be for her to have gotten away from it all so conveniently.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！あなたもみんに私の自由をうばわないでと叫びたくなるし、妹さんにも、もっと協力してって叫びたくなりますよね
dialogue.content: I see. It makes you want to scream at everyone, "Don't take away my freedom!" and at your sister, "Help me more!" doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 私の人生の足を引っ張るなって
dialogue.content: Like, "Don’t hold me back in my life."

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 私も自由になりたいって
dialogue.content: "I want to be free, too."

dialogue.origin: …言ってもどうしようもない時って、どう気持を整理すればいいんでしょう?
dialogue.content: When saying it doesn’t change anything, how am I supposed to process my feelings?

dialogue.origin: 今、それを言っても何も変わらないし。
dialogue.content: Saying it now wouldn't change anything.

dialogue.origin: 私も、貴女の立場だったら、そんなふうに、思います
dialogue.content: If I were in your position, I would feel the same way.

dialogue.origin: 辛さとかそういうやるせなさとか
dialogue.content: The pain, the frustration...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: よく、気持を前向きにするといいなんていうけど、前向きになんて…
dialogue.content: People often say it’s good to think positively, but being positive…

dialogue.origin: なかなかなれないです。
dialogue.content: It's really hard to do.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、今は、なかなかなれないですよね
dialogue.content: You're right. It's not easy to be positive right now.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お話しをまとめてみると
dialogue.content: So, to summarize what we've talked about...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: カウンセラーさんから見て、どんな感じですか?私。
dialogue.content: From your perspective as a counselor, how do things seem?

dialogue.origin: 今まで目標を持って、お金も貯めてぃたのに、、お父さんが、突然たおれて、みんな貴女の所におおいかぶさってきて、妹算もひとごとのよう。弟よろしいですか
dialogue.content: You had a goal and had saved up money, but then your father suddenly collapsed. Now everything is piling on you, and your sister acts as if it's none of her concern. Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.origin: 弟?
dialogue.content: Brother?

dialogue.origin: すみません、ダイビングまちがえました。
dialogue.content: Sorry, that was a typo.

dialogue.origin: 打ち間違いかな?
dialogue.content: A typo, maybe?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: おおいかぶさりを払いたいんです
dialogue.content: I want to shake off this burden.

dialogue.origin: 何か方法はありますか?
dialogue.content: Is there any way to do that?

dialogue.origin: もっと楽になって、スッキリしたいですよね
dialogue.content: You want to feel more at ease and relieved, don't you?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: それがわかれば、今は無理でも気持がちょっと落ち着くかも
dialogue.content: If I knew how, even if I can’t do it now, it might help me feel a bit calmer.

dialogue.origin: すごく良い提案が有ります。今日はそろそろじかんか来てしまいましたので、また次回来てくださいます。きっと、楽になりますよ
dialogue.content: I have a very good suggestion. However, we're almost out of time for today, so perhaps you could come back for another session. I'm sure it will help you feel better.

dialogue.origin: 提案は今は聞けませんか?
dialogue.content: Can't I hear the suggestion now?

dialogue.origin: 全部が無理なら、何か1つ聞きたいです
dialogue.content: If I can't hear all of it, I'd like to hear at least one thing.

dialogue.origin: 気になります
dialogue.content: I'm curious.

dialogue.origin: ちょっとの事でもいいんです
dialogue.content: Even just a little something would be fine.

dialogue.origin: はい、お父様のことを、行政にお願いするとか、ほうほうは、有ります。ゆっくり、一緒に考えていきましょうね
dialogue.content: Yes, there are methods, such as asking for government assistance for your father's care. Let's take our time and think it through together, okay?

dialogue.origin: 貴方にばかり負担をかけられないですもの
dialogue.content: We can't let the entire burden fall on you.

dialogue.origin: 行政に相談ですか。してみたけど、あまりいい感じの対応じゃなかったです。
dialogue.content: Government assistance? I've tried consulting them, but their response wasn't very helpful.

dialogue.origin: メンタル的に何かありませんか?
dialogue.content: Is there anything I can do on a mental level?

dialogue.origin: 気持の切り替え方とか。
dialogue.content: Like ways to shift my mindset.

dialogue.origin: 辛い気持を和らげる方法とか。
dialogue.content: Or ways to ease these painful feelings.

dialogue.origin: 我が家も同じ環境ですので、大丈夫です
dialogue.content: My family is in a similar situation, so don't worry.

dialogue.origin: 負担は私も嫌です。
dialogue.content: I don't want this burden either.

dialogue.origin: 同じ経験をされて来たんですか😳
dialogue.content: You've been through the same kind of experience? 😳

dialogue.origin: 私1人じゃないんですね
dialogue.content: So I'm not alone.

dialogue.origin: だったら、次回もう少し詳細な事を聞いてみたいです。
dialogue.content: In that case, I'd like to hear more details next time.

dialogue.origin: どうそれを乗り越えたかとか。
dialogue.content: Like how you overcame it.

dialogue.origin: 私も、、95再入なる。主人の父と同居しています。そうですよね、早く楽になりたいですよね。明日でも、これますか
dialogue.content: I also... my 95-year-old father-in-law lives with us. I understand that you want to feel better soon, right? Would you be able to come in tomorrow?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。どうにか時間作ります
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine. I'll make time somehow.

dialogue.origin: 95歳って、長生きされてますよね。
dialogue.content: 95 years old... he's lived a long life, hasn't he?

dialogue.origin: すごいなー。
dialogue.content: That's amazing.

dialogue.origin: カウンセラーさんがお世話されているんですか?それはそれで大変そう😳
dialogue.content: Are you the one taking care of him? That sounds tough in its own way. 😳

dialogue.origin: はい、おじいちゃん、メンタルが凄くをです
dialogue.content: Yes, my father-in-law, mentally he is very…

dialogue.origin: 痴呆ですか?
dialogue.content: Does he have dementia?

dialogue.origin: またうち間違いぴんぴんしています。
dialogue.content: Another typo. He's hale and hearty.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 明日、楽しくにしていてください
dialogue.content: Please look forward to tomorrow.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I will.

dialogue.origin: 今日はこれで、終了となりますが、よろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: We’ll end here for today, if that’s alright.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.content: That’s fine. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.origin: 感想はまたレポート提出します
dialogue.content: I’ll submit my feedback in a report later.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。合掌
dialogue.content: Thank you very much. (Bows)

topic.sub: 両親との関係における負担感
